Apple to Unveil New iPhone 18 Pro and Foldable Model

Apple is expected to launch its new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models on September 9. The company is also anticipated to introduce its first foldable iPhone, reportedly named iPhone Fold Ultra. Reports suggest these new models will feature upgraded specifications, including a new A20 Pro (2nm) chipset and improved battery backup compared to previous versions. A potential price increase for the Pro series and the foldable model is also indicated, attributed to rising component costs.
